assumptions: The original and repeat tests are authorized and use equivalent decisive preconditions.
Application B was not sampled in either run.
A failed retest does not identify the root cause by itself; it disproves the closure claim.
model.focalRelation: Control testing informs remediation by supplying a scoped failure path and repeatable evidence. Vulnerability management owns correction and closure, but closure requires verification of the original path and cannot be generalized to untested assets.

lanes.rule: Close only the tested claim supported by repeat evidence.

lanes.label: Untested scope
lanes.rule: Do not extend results to assets or paths not sampled.

model.scenario: A control test showed that an authenticated low-privilege user could reach an administrative export endpoint on application A. Vulnerability management linked a vendor patch, deployed it, and closed the ticket. A retest using the same authorized precondition and endpoint still reaches the export. Application B was not in the original or repeat scope.
